svg.title: Figure 2.1 · Reading Buying and Selling Pressure
svg.desc: Compare price progress with recorded activity. The chart shows behaviour; it does not identify who traded or why. The three panels compare progress, activity and follow-through. Illustrative practice bars are available in the linked CSV.
svg.text: Compare price progress with recorded activity. The chart
shows behaviour; it does not identify who traded or why.
Dashed line: average of prior 10 bars
Higher closes and swing lows show upward
Does price keep the progress it makes?
Dashed line: average of prior 10 bars
Activity increases while closes return to a
Dashed line: average of prior 10 bars
Lower highs and lower closes show downward
What evidence would weaken this reading?
Practice chart · describe evidence first, then test the next condition.
